title: The adoption census reruns on HEAD and every failing row becomes a defect task
body:
Why: Fable direction review 2026-11-14: every outside evidence predates tonight's adoption fixes; evals/adoption-census.md still reads 0/15.
Outcome: the census reruns on HEAD over the same 15 repos; evals/adoption-census.md is regenerated; every non-zero row becomes a defect task with command, exit and log path.
Proof: census table committed; >=12/15 adopt exit 0 or a defect task per failing row.
